title: Widget Native Migration
description: Refactor 5 from-scratch widgets and 4 minor cleanups in lib/ui/core/widgets/ to use Flutter's native Material widgets (FilledButton, IconButton, RawChip/ActionChip/InputChip, CircleAvatar, AlertDialog, TweenAnimationBuilder) instead of manual Container/GestureDetector/BoxDecoration stacks, while preserving the same public API. Adds three component themes (chipTheme, progressIndicatorTheme, snackBarTheme) to app_theme.dart so AppButton variants, chips, and snackbars inherit consistent defaults.
exit_criteria: AppButton uses FilledButton/OutlinedButton/TextButton (public API unchanged: AppButtonVariant, AppButtonSize, isLoading, isDisabled, isFullWidth preserved)
AppIconButton uses IconButton (public API unchanged: AppIconButtonSize, tooltip, color, onPressed preserved)
AppChip uses RawChip/ActionChip/InputChip (public API unchanged: ChipVariant, avatar, onDeleted, onPressed, color preserved; factory constructors preserved)
AppAvatar uses CircleAvatar for circle shape (public API unchanged: imageUrl, name, AvatarSize, AvatarShape preserved)
AppDialog uses AlertDialog (public API unchanged: confirm(), alert(), isDestructive, okLabel, icon preserved)
AppLoadingIndicator.pulse uses TweenAnimationBuilder (no AnimationController, no SingleTickerProviderStateMixin)
AppEmpty and AppError use AppButton.primary variant for CTA buttons (replaces FilledButton.icon)
app_theme.dart has chipTheme, progressIndicatorTheme, snackBarTheme in both light() and dark() builders
All widgets compile without errors (flutter analyze passes)
No new packages added to pubspec.yaml

subtasks.title: Theme additions (chipTheme, progressIndicatorTheme, snackBarTheme)
subtasks.summary: Add three component themes to lib/ui/core/theme/app_theme.dart so AppButton variants, AppChip, progress indicators, and snackbars inherit consistent defaults from ThemeData.

subtasks.title: AppButton — replace Container+GestureDetector with FilledButton/OutlinedButton/TextButton
subtasks.summary: Refactor lib/ui/core/widgets/buttons/app_button.dart: replace Container+GestureDetector stack with FilledButton (primary variant), OutlinedButton (secondary variant), and TextButton (ghost/tertiary variants). Preserve AppButtonVariant, AppButtonSize, isLoading, isDisabled, isFullWidth public API.

subtasks.title: AppIconButton — replace with IconButton
subtasks.summary: Refactor lib/ui/core/widgets/buttons/app_icon_button.dart: replace Container+GestureDetector stack with IconButton.filledTonal or IconButton, using visualDensity and constraints for the minimum 48dp touch target on md/lg. Preserve AppIconButtonSize, tooltip, color, onPressed.

subtasks.title: AppChip + PresenceChip — replace with RawChip/ActionChip/InputChip
subtasks.summary: Refactor lib/ui/core/widgets/display/app_chip.dart: map ChipVariant.filled to filled Material chip (RawChip with color), ChipVariant.outlined to OutlineChip via OutlinedChip style on RawChip, ChipVariant.soft to a colored RawChip with low alpha. Keep all factory constructors (presencePresent, presenceAbsent, memberRole, meetingStatus) and PresenceChip delegation working.

subtasks.title: AppAvatar — replace with CircleAvatar for circle shape
subtasks.summary: Refactor lib/ui/core/widgets/display/app_avatar.dart: when AvatarShape.circle, wrap the existing initials/icon Container with CircleAvatar (using backgroundColor and radius) and use CircleAvatar.backgroundImage for the network image. Keep AvatarShape.square and AvatarShape.roundedSquare paths using ClipRRect.

subtasks.title: AppDialog — replace with AlertDialog
subtasks.summary: Refactor lib/ui/core/widgets/feedback/app_dialog.dart: replace Dialog+Container+BoxDecoration stack in _ConfirmDialogContent and _AlertDialogContent with AlertDialog. Use AlertDialog.title, content, actions slots. Preserve confirm(), alert(), isDestructive, okLabel, icon public API.

subtasks.title: AppLoadingIndicator.pulse — replace AnimationController with TweenAnimationBuilder
subtasks.summary: Refactor lib/ui/core/widgets/feedback/app_loading_indicator.dart: delete _PulseIndicator StatefulWidget (and its SingleTickerProviderStateMixin + AnimationController) and replace with an implicit-animation TweenAnimationBuilder<double> that loops 0.6 -> 1.0 -> 0.6. Respect MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) by returning a static dot when animations are disabled.

subtasks.title: AppEmpty + AppError — replace raw FilledButton.icon with AppButton
subtasks.summary: Refactor lib/ui/core/widgets/state/app_empty.dart and lib/ui/core/widgets/state/app_error.dart: replace raw FilledButton.icon CTA with AppButton.primary (icon prop + label). Depends on Batch 2 because AppButton must exist before these widgets import it.
